+def parse_duration(duration: str) -> int:
+    """Parse hours, minutes and seconds into milliseconds.
+
+    A string containing only digits is already in milliseconds.
+    """
+    duration = duration.strip()
+    if re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]+', duration):
+        return int(duration)
+
+    match = re.fullmatch(
+        r'(?:(?P<h>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)h\s*)?'
+        r'(?:(?P<m>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)m\s*)?'
+        r'(?:(?P<s>[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)s)?', duration)
+    if match is None or not any(match.groupdict().values()):
+        raise ValueError('Invalid duration: {!r}'.format(duration))
+
+    return int(sum(Decimal(value) * multiplier
+                   for value, multiplier in zip(match.groups(),
+                                                (3600000, 60000, 1000))
+                   if value is not None))
